description: Published results for the Kim, Kim & Sahoo (2006) waste-collection VRPTW instances that were read in an accessible document on 2026-11-15. Distance in miles (Manhattan on the instances' feet coordinates), objective total distance, unlimited homogeneous fleet.

sources.kim2006: Kim, B.-I., Kim, S., Sahoo, S. (2006). Waste collection vehicle routing problem with time windows. Computers & Operations Research 33(12):3624-3642. doi:10.1016/j.cor.2005.02.045. Values as tabulated by Benjamin (2011), Table 3.3(a) (clustering heuristic).
sources.benjamin2011: Benjamin, A.M. (2011). Metaheuristics for the waste collection vehicle routing problem with time windows. PhD thesis, Brunel University. https://bura.brunel.ac.uk/bitstream/2438/5254/1/FulltextThesis.pdf . Table 6.14, rows 'Thesis' (without the vehicle-reduction procedure).
sources.literature_bks_2016: Best known solution before 2016 as listed by Markov, Varone & Bierlaire (2016), Table 4, column 'BKS from literature / Best' (attributed there to Benjamin 2011 or Buhrkal et al. 2012). Preprint: https://infoscience.epfl.ch/record/208988/files/MarVarBier2015.pdf
sources.markov2016: Markov, I., Varone, S., Bierlaire, M. (2016). Integrating a heterogeneous fixed fleet and a flexible assignment of destination depots in the waste collection VRP with intermediate facilities. Transportation Research Part B 84:256-273. Preprint Table 4, column 'This work / Best' (first five instances only; vehicles 3, 3, 6, 11, 5).

not_verified: Buhrkal, Larsen & Ropke (2012, Procedia - Social and Behavioral Sciences 39:241-254) report results for all ten instances; the article could not be retrieved, so their values for 1051-2100 are not included and may be lower than the Benjamin (2011) values used below.
